BusinessStatus.description: Whether the IP address pool is locked. Normal: Normal. FinancialLocked: Financially locked.

CidrBlock.description: Example: 101.0.XX.XX/24, IP address range. Only IPv4 address ranges are supported and cannot start with 0. Mask range: 23–30. Note: Only one of CidrBlock or CidrMask can be configured.

CidrBlocks.description: IP range information in the IP address pool.

CidrMask.description: IP address range mask. Range: 24–28. After entering the mask, the IP address range will be automatically assigned. Note: Only one of CidrBlock or CidrMask can be configured.

CreationTime.description: Creation time of the IP address pool.

DeletedTime.description: Resource reclaim time. This parameter is returned only when the resource is shut down due to overdue payment.

Description.description: Description of the IP address pool.

ISP.description: Line type. Valid values: BGP (multi-line), ChinaMobile (China Mobile static single line), ChinaTelecom (China Telecom static single line), ChinaUnicom (China Unicom static single line), SingleLine_BGP (BGP single line), Premium_BGP (Premium BGP), Fusion_BGP (Fusion BGP), ChinaMobile_Value (China Mobile Value static single line), ChinaUnicom_Value (China Unicom Value static single line), ChinaTelecom_Value (China Telecom Value static single line).

IpAddressPoolId.description: ID of the IP address pool.

Name.description: Name of the IP address pool.

OverdueTime.description: Resource freeze time. This parameter is returned only when the resource is frozen due to overdue payment.

ProjectName.description: Name of the project to which the IP address pool belongs.

Status.description: Status of the IP address pool. Creating: Creating. Available: Available. Deleting: Deleting. Pending: In configuration.

Tags.description: Tag information of the IP address pool.

TotalIpCount.description: Total number of IP addresses contained in the IP address pool.

UpdateTime.description: Update time of the IP address pool.

UsedIpCount.description: Number of IP addresses allocated as EIP in the IP address pool.
